Title: Gradient Computation and Backward Propagation
Summary: The video derives explicit expressions for partial derivatives, including ∂C/∂a^l = 2(a^l - y), ∂a^l/∂z^l = σ'(z^l), and ∂z^l/∂w^l = a^{l-1}. It demonstrates how these combine via the chain rule to compute gradients, and introduces the concept of propagating error signals backward through layers to update weights and biases.
